name: pool
title: Pool
owns: Pool storage and migrations; admission records; Imperatives; accepted specifications; original rules and their projections, including temporary rules with an expiry or lift condition; generated knowledge projections; and the questions and decision rounds of the Mind's word. It is the one store that word persists decisions in.

commands.name: hive-pool
commands.purpose: Durable Pool items: identity, level, scope, dependencies, delivery path, dispatch class, requested place, holds, dates and generations; the questions and decision rounds the Mind's word persists; legacy import and export.

commands.name: hive-admit
commands.purpose: Immutable admission requests and receipts bound to an Imperative revision.

commands.name: hive-imperative
commands.purpose: The canonical Imperative: text, revision and digest, and what was delivered for each generation.

commands.name: hive-spec
commands.purpose: Specification revisions, acceptance receipts, requirement and evidence links, closure receipts.

commands.name: hive-rule
commands.purpose: Verbatim rulings, amendments, scope, effective and expiry times, supersession and the resolved-rule digest.

commands.name: hive-memory
commands.purpose: Generated knowledge projections, the maintenance queue and per-consumer acknowledgment.

receipt_kinds.asserts: An item was added to the Pool with its identity, scope and requested place.
An item moved from one state to another, with the evidence the caller gave.
A hold of the stated kind was placed on an item for the reason given.
A hold on an item was released on the evidence named.
An execution generation of an item was opened under an admitted admission, with the place requested at that moment.
An execution generation was closed with the outcome and evidence the caller reported.
An admission request was recorded immutably, bound to an Imperative revision and digest.
An admission check found every required field present, the placement admissible and the authority sufficient, for the Imperative revision and item revision it read.
An admission check refused dispatch of an Imperative revision for the findings recorded.
An admission check held dispatch of an Imperative revision on the hold named.
The Mind's word named was recorded as the required ruling for an admission.
A revision of an item's canonical Imperative was recorded with its digest and the Placement axis copied from the item.
One Imperative revision, at the rendered digest, was delivered to one generation by the transport named.
A specification revision was recorded with its criteria and digest.
A specification revision was accepted for an item by the supervisor named.
An acceptance was invalidated by a later revision that changed an accepted criterion.
Accepted requirements were closed against the landed head, landing and proof named.
A ruling was recorded verbatim with its subject, scope, authority, rule line and effective time.
An attributed amendment of a rule's operation was recorded, leaving its words and dates unchanged.
A rule's expiry time was noticed and honoured by its owner.
A rule's lift condition was met by the receipt named and the lift was honoured.
A knowledge projection was rendered from the sources named, at their revisions, with its digest.
One consumer received a projection at the rendering and digest named.
One consumer acknowledged a projection at the rendering and digest named.
A legacy backlog was imported under the identity migration named, with its source digest.
A question was raised for the Hive Mind at revision 1, with its card in a decision round and the word hold it answers for.
A question was given its next revision, whole, and its card's presentation revision was raised.
An answer was recorded exactly as given against the current revision of a question, with its source, and the question now stands on it with its disposition pending.
An applied answer of a question was replaced by a later answer that names it.
An answer given against an earlier revision of a question was recorded exactly as submitted and applied to nothing.
A question was deferred by a Later answer against its current revision, with that answer's revisit date.
The owner recorded the disposition released for a question's applied answer, with its note.
The owner recorded the disposition completed for a question's applied answer, with its note, and no work was released by it.
A question with no applied answer was closed as moot on the evidence named, with no answer recorded or implied.

test_scope: Record round trips, transitions, concurrent writes, migration and recovery, and rule expiry by the clock and lift by receipt. From stage 2: byte-exact legacy round trip and identity migration; admission with each requested place, Codex Cloud refused, a Void place refused for a local-only project and held for an unpushed branch; criteria carried from Pool to Imperative by revision; deterministic rendering; a home inside a repository refused; a persistent Fleet never an ordinary task; no worktree assumed; dependencies satisfied only by the completion marker kept through archival, a date-less imported completion included, and checked before every generation opens; export placing each item in the section of its state; identity reads that recover first; an imported dated word hold still blocking after its date; secrets by reference only; and the records and operations of the Mind's word: an answer idempotent by source within its question, a late answer and a late Later recorded unreconciled, a disposition only on an applied answer and a moot close only on evidence that holds, and the six refused to any caller but a handoff from hive-word.
